name: Action Complexity
research_question: Does current Google Flow execute one atomic physical action more reliably than a dependent multi-step sequence in the same continuous clip?
hypothesis: ATOMIC will improve completion, physical plausibility and hand correctness without reducing product fidelity.

conditions.MULTI_STEP: grip -> open -> release -> remove P1 -> replace same P1 -> re-grip -> close -> hold

controls: product, black variant, initial state, three props, hand assignment, scene, camera, lighting, reference, model, mode, duration, aspect ratio and output count
